title: Compact Tiered Sidebar with Progressive Workspace History
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Reduce cognitive overhead and switching time between workspaces and frequently used console routes by introducing a compact, tiered sidebar that surfaces progressive workspace history and quick route actions. Scope: replace current oversized left navigation for logged-in users on desktop widths >=1200px with a 3-tier compact pane: 1) Primary scope (workspace selector + high-level product areas), 2) Recent lanes (time-ordered workspace history and pinned routes), 3) Context tray (route-specific quick actions like duplicate, clone, open rollout, view cost breakdown). Deliverables: interactive Figma prototype, accessibility checklist, animation spec (100-200ms micro-transitions), telemetry events spec, handoff package for frontend. Constraints: must fit within existing console chrome, preserve keyboard shortcuts and command palette behavior, maintain token-cost visibility in route-level quick actions. Success metrics: reduce average workspace switch time by 30%, decrease misclick rate on navigation by 25%, increase usage of pinned routes by 40% in first 6 weeks. Stakeholders: Product (Riley Chen), PM (Maya Singh), Engineering (Gabriel Ruiz), Design Research (Priya Shah), Security/Compliance (Audit team).
